name: revenue-expense-tracker
description: Australian personal finance, investment and tax-year tracker for retail investors, property investors, retirees and pensioners.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.db:sync: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ] && { [ -n "$DIRECT_URL" ] || [ -n "$DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED" ]; }; then DIRECT_URL="${DIRECT_URL:-$DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED}" npm run prisma:push --workspace=backend -- --skip-generate; else echo "db:sync skipped (only runs for Vercel production builds with a database URL set)"; fi
scripts.build:vercel: npm run db:sync && npm run build:frontend
